Adverse Effects and Precautions Some patients have had transient nausea, vomiting, headaches, arthralgia, fatigue, vertigo, raised liver enzymes, pruritus, and skin rashes. Metabolism of the inosine content of inosine pranobex leads to increased serum and urine concentrations of uric acid; caution is therefore recommended in treating patients with renal impairment, gout, or hyperuricaemia.
